_comment: Evaluator tunables (non-secret; committed). Only LITELLM_API_KEY and LITELLM_API_BASE live in .env. Set the model ids below to exact ids your LiteLLM proxy serves. 'council' is the default judge set (resolved against the proxy at runtime; a member the proxy doesn't serve is dropped, and a missing second claude-sonnet is auto-picked). 'backup_judge' restores an odd-sized council, or is the fallback judge if the configured council would otherwise be empty. 'samples' is how many times each model is called in scoring mode. 'output_temperature' is for the compared models (judges always run at 0).
